slots.sentence: Japan is the largest foreign holder of U.S. government debt — Japanese investors own more than $1 trillion in U.S. Treasuries — and the typical move to defend Japan’s rapidly depreciating currency would be to sell its Treasuries to support the currency, which had sank to a 40-year low.
